notes.title: 1.0.21 - Cloud Saving + Costume Updates + Lots of bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!!!



Thank you for a wonderful release! We're sitting at 100% positive reviews, which is incredibly heartwarming!!! We appreciate the love so much! Thank you for your patience and generosity. We want to continue making games that fill people with joy and make the world a better place. Your support helps us do that!



Since release, we've made a few updates mostly fixing small bugs that people have mentioned. There are too many to mention individually, but here's a few special things we want to call out:

We now support Steam Cloud Saving!

Simon/Sebastian scene near the summit now plays correctly.

Reordered Lost Dogs in collectibles screen in Summit Ascent page. Will not affect your collection of them. 

Save files now track total play time and rescued dogs (Apologies - your playtime before version 1.0.17 is lost.)

Pig Hat exists! (And fixes to some other costumes)

Rainforest Retreats Fruit Hats now show their icons in the menu.

Unicorn and Chicken costume have unique poops :)

Once again, there are many bug fixes we can't list. We are continuing to work on more features and fixes. 



From our release + PAX West, we raised enough to donate $1,500 to Dog Gone Seattle! Thank you for your purchases and support. We will be making the first donation for this game October 1st (after we receive payment from Steam).



If you'd like to support us more: 

LEAVE A REVIEW - This helps us in Steam's algorithm.

Continue to tell us about more bugs, feature requests, and things you love on our Discord. 

Spread the word - tell people to buy our game and wishlist! 

Buy a copy of the game as a gift for your friends :) You can gift it during checkout.

Follow our Developer page: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/scalisco - Stay tuned for our future games.

Buy our original soundtrack, composed by Sam Shandley. We're very happy with the cozy tunes he made and 10% of soundtrack purchases will also get donated :) [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3984640/A_Corgis_Cozy_Hike_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you once again! And remember to Live Like A Dog!

~Dan
